hunks.sol: *How could five people possibly fight something like that? They must all be dead by now.*

hunks.sol: “What if even one of them survives and escapes?”

hunks.sol: Won Myunghoon addressed the hesitant Guild members in a firm voice.

hunks.baseline: “If even one of those losers survives and gets out of the Gate, every single one of us is finished.”
hunks.sol: “If even one of those losers gets out of the Gate alive, every last one of us is finished.”

hunks.baseline: Even if the survivor couldn’t provide clear testimony or physical evidence, the contempt and condemnation directed at them would not disappear.
hunks.sol: Even if the survivor couldn’t provide definitive testimony or physical evidence, the contempt and condemnation directed at them would never disappear.

hunks.baseline: They might even have to leave the country. They would be reduced to people who needed a visa just to visit their parents’ graves.
hunks.sol: They might even have to flee the country, reduced to applying for visas just to visit their parents’ graves.

hunks.baseline: “Sometimes, people’s perception matters more than the truth. You all experienced that eight years ago, didn’t you?”
hunks.sol: “Sometimes, what people believe matters more than the truth. You all learned that eight years ago, didn’t you?”

hunks.baseline: Agitation spread violently among the Star Guild members.

hunks.baseline: It was an unspoken taboo. Yet Won Myunghoon himself had brought it up.
hunks.sol: It was an unspoken taboo, yet Won Myunghoon himself had brought it up.

hunks.baseline: At the Guild members’ hardened gazes, Won Myunghoon let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: Not until their dying breaths.

hunks.sol: “Choose your words carefully. Hearing you say that makes me want to split your head open.”

hunks.sol: “What an insolent bastard. There’s nothing he won’t say to an elder. Right?”

hunks.sol: At the same time, the last of my hesitation faded, and my mind became clear.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe not. Then let’s go?”
hunks.sol: “Or not. Here I come.”
